messages:
Rhea: Heads-up: planning the release announcement for next Wed. Need final changelog, docs links, a one-line bench hook, and confirmation of the webinar demo flow. Can eng confirm rollout timing and rollback criteria?

Emir: I'll draft the changelog entry and add rollout/rollback bullets. Tentative rollout: 20m canary -> 90m staged -> full, with automatic rollback on p95 >10% regression. Need SRE slot.

Nina: Docs ready in draft. I need the final API example and the official model name string to update code samples and snippets. Also please send any sample responses we should show in the guide.

Kai: For the webinar we want: 10m product overview, 25m live demo (streaming + tools), 15m customer Q&A. We need a short script for the demo happy path and one fallback script in case the demo model falls back to quantized variant. Please hand both to DevRel by Monday noon.

Sam: Marketing messaging request: headline that sells predictable performance and lower unit cost with a trust cue about canary rollouts. Workshop copy: "Predictable latency. Lower cost. Safer rollouts." Need bench blurb: can someone give a tight stat?

Emir: Perf quickline: median latency down ~13% on our standard chat load; token unit cost down ~10% with default batching. I'll paste the perf report link once the numbers are finalized. PR for changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/910

Rhea: Great. @Emir can you confirm SRE window? Also we need the embargo window for press and the landing page link for registration to wire into lead routing.

Emir: SRE confirmed deploy slot: 2026-04-29T14:00:00Z (canary 20m). DeployBot will orchestrate staged rollout.

DeployBot: Deploy scheduled: release v1.14.2 at 2026-04-29T14:00:00Z (canary 20m, staged 90m). Rollback trigger: p95 regression >10%.

Nina: Published docs page (internal) at https://redwood.docs.internal/release/v1.14.2/draft. Will replace with public link once changelog PR merges and we have the official model name. Added placeholder curl + JS snippets.

Kai: Lead routing: we will push hot leads from the webinar signup form to Sales real-time. Marketing, ensure the form asks region and company size so Sales can prioritize. Also confirm GDPR consent text on the landing page.

Rhea: Action list: Emir finish changelog + perf link, Nina publish public docs link after merge, Kai finalize demo scripts and lead routing config, Sam finalize hero copy with the bench blurb. Please ack and note any blockers.

Emir: ack, will update PR with rollback details by EOD today.

Nina: ack, will swap to public URL after PR merge.

Kai: ack, will deliver demo scripts Mon 11:00 PT.

Sam: ack, will send hero copy and landing draft by tomorrow morning.

Rhea: Thanks. Small change: canary start moved +15min; DeployBot updated schedule. Also embargo window: press embargo lifts 24h after full rollout.

DeployBot: Updated deploy schedule: canary start 2026-04-29T14:15:00Z.

Rhea: Final note for comms: if any perf alerts fire during canary we abort and notify marketing within 5 minutes so we can pause press. Keep monitoring dashboards open for the deploy.

Emir: will add watch alerts and escalation channel.
